name: 琼脂
title: 琼脂
description: A seaweed-derived polysaccharide used as a gelling, thickening and stabilising food additive, identified in the EU as E406.
what_is: A seaweed-derived polysaccharide used as a gelling, thickening and stabilising food additive, identified in the EU as E406.
why_botia: BOTIA flags E406 because labels may use agar, agar-agar or the E-number. The declaration identifies the texturising ingredient but not its amount or grade.
can_1: Detect E406, agar and agar-agar when declared.
can_2: Trigger texture and E-number information for the ingredient.
cannot_1: Determine concentration, gel strength or raw-material species from the ingredient list.
cannot_2: Treat the presence of an authorised texturiser as a risk signal by itself.

sources.label: Regulation (EC) No 1333/2008 — Union list and conditions of use for food additives
Commission Regulation (EU) No 231/2012 — specifications for authorised food additives

aliases: E406, INS 406, agar, agar-agar, agar agar
